title: Tier-2 miner: two Mining Laser III and a second Laser II into the empty utility slots of a Resonance Miner at Ironlight Crossroads, LHS 1140
note: Written by Zero 2026-11-24 18:09 UTC (orders ENT-090 block ZERO: tier-2 hulls as they deliver; rule F17: T2+ modules in batches). A Resonance Miner comes from the Node Beta yard with a Mining Laser II and a Shield Booster II: 4 utility slots, cpu 28, power 48 (table hulls). Two Laser III (6/12 each) and a second Laser II (4/8) fill the three empty slots: 23 cpu, 46 power with the booster (catalog 0.734.2), mining power 68 against 34 of a Threshold with Laser III and II. LHS 1140 asks Laser III 6,619 x 20 and Laser II 3,776 x 20 (book 17:43 UTC); Central Nexus asks 20,540 x 3. fit count is the total of that module fitted (route_run.py), so a hull fitted already is skipped; requires.hull matches the ship's class name, both spellings given.
